Mod.Name: Dynamic Shadows
Mod.Author: manuc
Mod.Description:
Real 3D scenery, lighting and dynamic shadows over the field maps of Final Fantasy IX.
It derives a true perspective camera from BGCAM_DEF, draws a second 3D pass over the game's render and puts the character into it: they receive the scene's light and cast a shadow onto the geometry, occluding correctly against it. The prerendered backgrounds are kept; what is added is the 3D layer that goes with them.
Every map brings its own baked Unity scene in a bundle named after its map number (150.unity3d for Cast. Alex./Guard). A map with no bundle plays exactly as it does without the mod.
IMPORTANT: this mod does NOT work on data alone. It needs the Assembly-CSharp.dll from this build of Memoria, because the 3D pass is engine code and Memoria's mod system does not load code. Install the DLL that ships with the release before enabling the mod.
Mod.PatchNotes: 0.1.0 - First publishable version. - Perspective camera derived from the field, pixel exact - Real directional light and shadows cast onto the geometry - Character in the 3D pass, with correct shadow and depth - Unity scenes loaded with baked lightmaps and light probes - Maps included: 64, 150 (Cast. Alex./Guard), 151
Mod.CompatibilityNotes: It replaces Assembly-CSharp.dll, so it is incompatible with any other mod that also replaces that DLL. Mods that only add data (textures, text, music, models) coexist with it without trouble.
